pr_title: release-19.1: sql: reject CTAS queries with window functions
pr_body:
Window functions do not have a local execution mode anymore, but
CREATE TABLE AS uses only local execution which leads to a panic
when window functions are present in the source statement. Now
we will be rejecting such queries and hinting at upgrading to 19.2
since such feature is supported there.

cc @cockroachdb/release

Fixes: #40409.

Release note (bug fix): a crash caused by presence of window functions
in the source of CREATE TABLE AS statement is fixed.
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/40430)

root@127.0.0.1:49784/defaultdb> insert into a values (1), (2);

Time: 2.752ms

root@127.0.0.1:49784/defaultdb> create table b as (select row_number() over (), * from a);
E190903 15:59:02.541956 71 sql/conn_executor.go:708  [n1,client=127.0.0.1:49786,user=root] a SQL panic has occurred while executing "CREATE TABLE b AS (SELECT row_number() OVER (), * FROM a)": windowNode can't be run in local mode

I'm not sure, however, how to fix it because the computation of window functions is done only by `windower`. Maybe @jordanlewis has ideas?
It seems that this is not a problem for 19.2 because the execution of `CREATE TABLE AS` has been rewritten by Aditya, and it now uses DistSQL infrastructure.

We're still fixing significant bugs in 19.1 IIRC? 

The proper fix here in 19.1 would be to reject the CREATE AS plan if it contains window functions (with perhaps a hint that it's available in 19.2).

Yes, my comment was not about not fixing this issue for 19.1, just what I noticed when triaging.

I agree with your suggestion on rejecting the CTAS query with window functions.
